chain_words.nuance: belonging to an earlier time, without strong emphasis on age
having existed for a long time
belonging to a very distant past
old-fashioned and no longer in use
existing from the very beginning of time

explanation: These words all describe something from the past, from a recent former era to the very origins of time.

usage_notes.difference: 'Ancient' describes things from a very distant past; 'archaic' describes something old-fashioned that is no longer used or fashionable.
